chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ali ibn Sulayman said:
I wrote to the Man (peace be upon him) asking him what he says regarding the Salat al-Tasbih while riding (in a conveyance), so he wrote: 'If you are traveling, pray.'

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: The Man (referring to Imam al-Rida, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing Salat al-Tasbih while riding during travel?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the practical flexibility of Salat al-Tasbih, with Imam al-Rida (AS) confirming its validity during travel, thereby addressing the specific context of performing devotions while in transit. It underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that the conditions of prayer can be adapted to the traveler's state, ensuring spiritual continuity without undue hardship. This ruling is particularly significant in distinguishing between the obligatory nature of the prayer and the permissibility of its performance in a simplified manner while on a conveyance.
